text: Angel One's commodity trading doubled. So why did its share drop twenty one points?
Clue one. Today: two thousand four hundred and thirty eight billion a day. Forty four percent.
Clue two. A year ago, eleven eighty seven billion. Sixty five point one percent.
The twist. Divide turnover by share. The market went from eighteen hundred to fifty five hundred billion a day. It tripled.
Its futures and options share held. New commodity traders went elsewhere. Back to the napkin.
